title: Newton
author: JG
description: C++: check if SysError(s) in CSolverBase::Newton() can be changed into regular failure and step reduction for adaptiveStep
releaseNotes: With adaptiveStep or automatic step size, a singular system Jacobian is a failed step, which is reduced; a singularity of the model ends the run at the minimum step size with the causing coordinate (revision2026b step RG4.19.4)
